research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: DataStax is researching and developing methods for data streaming between nodes of a database system, as described in 'Data streaming between nodes of a database system,' which details how nodes in a cluster transfer data segments efficiently. Additionally, 'Trie-based indices for databases' outlines the use of byte ordering for keys and trie indices to reference stored data, enhancing database indexing. These areas reflect a focus on distributed database performance and indexing techniques.

product.name: Astra DB
product.description: A cloud-based NoSQL database built on Apache Cassandra that supports vector search, multi-model data, and scalable real-time workloads for generative AI applications.

product.name: Hyper-converged Database (HCD)
product.description: An on-premises and private-cloud NoSQL database based on Apache Cassandra, with vector capabilities for AI workloads and real-time application data.

product.name: Langflow
product.description: An open-source, low-code framework for prototyping, building, and deploying retrieval-augmented generation and multi-agent AI applications.
